reason: The BEFORE code types the fallback key parameter as `key: string` (and the map as `Record<string, any>`), so `c.set(MY_SYMBOL, v)` / `c.set(1, v)` genuinely fail to compile despite the underlying `Map` accepting them — exactly the defect the linked issue/PR and commit fix by widening to `PropertyKey`; the reviewer only misstates the direction of the change, not the substance of the problem in the before code.
